notes.title: Server issues
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are currently experiencing server issues. Our team is working to resolve them as soon as possible. We will notify you once the server is back online.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: "No connection" problem will be solved as soon as possible.
notes.notes: Hello everyone. We are trying to fix it already. We are aware of problem. Please stay calm and give us the time.

notes.title: Let's fix everything!
notes.notes:
Attention! During last few month the forum has accumulated a lot of messages about bugs! 

Please, all of you who have unsolved issues and you want it to be solved, please, send me your saves. My email is kp@jetdogs.com

Your saves in the folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Roaming/Artogon/Wanderland/Persistence/

In the topic of the email please write WANDERLAND FIX.

In the body of the email write:
1. your ID in Wanderland
2. detailed description of the problem

All issues will be solving only in this way. I will be ignoring all bugs reporting on forums and in JetDogs group.Thank you for being patient and for understanding.

Regards,
Karyna

notes.title: Dear Wanderland Contributors!​
notes.notes:
Words can't express how ​much ​we appreciate your work​​!
But the Wanderland ​project finally has ​a ​deadline.​ On January 15, 2018, the Wanderland ​project will be closed ​o​n POEditor. ​Any language files that aren't finished by then will be placed in a Google folder and shared publically.

On to the rewards for ​the languages​ that are finished by January 15, 2018!​

Reward 1​:​
If​ a) the language you have been a contributor in is finished and​ you b) have translated over 5%​ and c) are in top 10 of contributors​, we will ​add your name in game credits​. For this to happen, please email your ​name​ as you want it listed​ and​ the​ language ​you contributed to Karyna​ at kp@jetdogs.com​.​


Reward 2​:​
In addition, if a) the language you've been a contributor in is finished and you b) have ​translated more than 15% of translated ​of the game's text and c) are ​one of the top 3 ​​contributors​, we'll ​happily ​send you​ a​ special ​JetDogs ​certificate ​that names you as a translator for the Wanderland project​!.
​Please email your name ​as you want it listed ​and ​the ​language of your contribution​ to Karyna​ at kp@jetdogs.com​.​ 


Finally, please be sure to ​ask Karyna ​what ​benefits you ​can have more (keys, ​game ​resources​, etc.) if you ​are in either of these two reward categories.

​Thank you for your fabulous contribution to the Wanderland language project!
Your friends at JetDogs

notes.title: News!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,
 
We are delighted to see how enthusiastically a lot of you started translating our favorite game Wanderland into your native languages, and we would like to express our large gratitude to you. As to continue, the Chinese (simplified) localization of the game is as good as ready and ready to be launched in due time. Speaking of that, we would like to thank particularly Joanne (cheekiyaya - http://steamcommunity.com/id/bunniebunnie ) for doing enormous work at a record pace.
 
As to other localizations, the German translation is done up to 84%, Portuguese up to 61%, Spanish up to 48%, Hungarian up to 46%, Dutch up to 45%, Polish up to 43% etc. It is high time now for you to join your colleagues and contribute to the development of the game in order to bring into world Wanderland translated into your native language!

Don’t hesitate to take on translating the game into your languages as well as ask questions and participate in the project development. We wish you successful completing of quests and flawless victory over all the monsters!

Join the project: https://poeditor.com/join/project/vmdjclqdjj

notes.title: Bring Wanderland into your language!
notes.notes:
JetDogs is announcing a fabulous opportunity for fans to be part of the team for Wanderland, the game with a deep storyline, fairy tale graphics and amazing locations! How By helping us localize Wanderland into your native language. You'll win some great awards, too: Every contributor who translators more than 5% of the text will get 3 copies of any JetDogs game and 3 copies of any Wanderland DLCs of their choice. Even better, when the project is finished, the Top 10 contributors for each language (in volume) will get a special prize: all the Wanderland DLCs and a copy of every JetDogs game! We especially need translations into German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean, but we welcome any languages that we don't already have. Don't see your native language? Don't worry: you can add any language you want to the project. Start ​participating here: https://poeditor.com/join/project/vmdjclqdjj. Make sure to read the technical specs first​, and ​ do not change, translate or delete any of the following: 1) ​%d or%s 2) Anything between "<" and ">". For example
should not be translated, and for " 1 energy I want to eat ​," only “1 energy” and “I want to eat” should get translated. ​3) &nbps:; 4) If you don't know the context of some sentences or for some words, please, ask in the comments, we will answer to you and explain the context. ​We're looking forward to get your translations! P.S. Please, don't try to goodle translate it! We'll check it and ban participant.

notes.title: More than gold is buried in Wanderland!
notes.notes:
More than gold is buried in Wanderland: you'll also find keys, powerful keys that open up passages to other worlds for you.
Journey to the dark void of outer space in "Galaxy Admirals." Travel back in time to ancient Greece with the "12 Labours of Hercules." Or even visit the mysterious, creepy universe of "Cursed."
Once per month whenever you spend over $2.99 USD in Wanderland, you'll get a random bonus reward key for one of JetDogs' great games.
So wander through Wanderland and be rewarded!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/545820/
